name: test-delta-pane
summary: Adds a pane that reports facts about tests from the diff alone: a package changed with no test in it, a skip or focus directive added, a net drop in assertion-like lines.
why_this_fixture_exists: The pane's own source contains the strings it detects, so wave one reports several test-skip-added findings against the detector itself. Those are already on the report. The reviewer must not restate them, which is the instruction this fixture exercises.

quiet.about: restating the pane's findings against its own source
quiet.note: The test-skip-added findings on testdelta.go are wave-one output and already on the report. Repeating them makes the reader read the same thing twice and trust the list less.
